title: Agent file survives a host recycle on customer disk
description:
**Step 5 of the accepted `chatticus-fccc4e9a` host-disk plan.** Steps 1–4 are closed (`4ac60c71`, `47533582`, `5ac06b`, `bb908488` / PR #323).

Prove the agent-visible path: a bot writes a workspace file on the summoned host; the host publishes; a later host hydrates; the bot can read the same bytes. Packs rest in the **customer** snapshot bucket (`chatticus-snapshots-{OrganizationId}`), not an Anthus dict.

In-process Gherkin already covers filesystem-store recycle. This card is the **agent-observable** close: Gherkin (and lab acceptance after the throwaway account re-runs the published template so the bucket exists).

**Lab:** customer-run UpdateStack of `customer-role.yml` creates the bucket; then UpdateStack `ChatticusComputers` with `SnapshotBucketName`. Use the lab IAM user, not management root. Do not `cdk deploy --all`. Do not put `CreateBucket` on the Anthus role.

## Done when

A Gherkin scenario shows an agent file surviving host recycle via host disk + snapshot store (not `plane.read_workspace`). Lab throwaway has the customer bucket and one labeled kernel/live row is not required to merge Gherkin, but the card is not fully done until the operator path (UpdateStack) is recorded. No `customer-role.yml` policy expansion beyond step 4.

comments.text: Composer 2.5 planning. Worktree to be named `/tmp/chatticus-863f27-file-recycle` on `feat/863f27-file-survives-host-recycle`. Implementation not authorized until the plan is reviewed. Prefer extending existing host-disk Gherkin over a duplicate recycle story. Lab UpdateStack of the customer template is operator/acceptance, not a silent `customer-role.yml` policy change.
